## Checks

- [ ] `npm test`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build` all pass
- [ ] A bug fix comes with the test that would have caught it
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under `## Unreleased` if anything user-visible moved
- [ ] Conventional Commit in the title (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:` …)

## If the drawing or the animation moved

- [ ] Looked at it rendered, at `size={30}` as well as large
- [ ] Checked both variants
- [ ] Checked `mono` on a dark ground
- [ ] Checked `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`

<!-- A before/after screenshot or recording is worth more than any description
     of a one-pixel change. -->
